brief:
A Palestinian family sat atop the rubble of their destroyed home in Masafer Yatta, in the southern West Bank governorate of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The Israeli military has repeatedly demolished homes in the area, which is designated as a firing zone.

Masafer Yatta comprises 18 villages whose residents have faced decades of displacement pressure and home demolitions by Israeli forces.
title: Israeli forces destroy Palestinian family home in Masafer Yatta
